page.overview:
What is Forest?

Forest is a City subtheme released in 2012 that is centered around camping, dirt bike riding, firefighting and crime in the country. It features many new moulds and newly printed pieces. The police rangers' subtheme has a colour scheme like past police sets, but with more blue, and new ranger and pilot printed torsos and heads. The robber's vehicles have a common dark red/black/grey colour scheme and also new printed Crook torsos and heads. The fire subtheme features a red/white/yellow colour scheme along with new firemen printed torsos and the first red fire helmets made by LEGO.

Other sets related to forest theme (Note the forest in the background box art).
